tailoring.headline: Product Manager E-Commerce & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional E-Commerce Developer and Consultant with 5+ years of professional experience building enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong foundation in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, customer experience architectures, integrations and agile product delivery. Combines deep backend expertise with requirements engineering, process mapping and stakeholder management. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Manager Customer Experience & E-Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: Your focus on delivering exceptional customer experience and innovative e-commerce solutions at FIS Group aligns perfectly with my background in enterprise platform engineering. Over the past 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have combined deep technical expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud with rigorous techno-functional analysis to bridge business and IT stakeholders.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes, and translated them into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Customer Experience & APIs
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and Headless APIs to support seamless customer interactions and third-party digital channels.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved integration bottlenecks across SAP ERP and MDM platforms for global e-commerce operations.

bullets.label: Agile Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with international technical and business teams, writing user stories and functional specifications to steer complex feature delivery.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional expertise can support FIS Group.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and techno-functional expertise to FIS Group and Medienwerft to help drive exceptional customer experience solutions. Your leadership in digital business and SAP commerce environments offers an ideal platform to combine my technical depth in SAP Commerce Cloud with my strong background in requirements analysis and stakeholder collaboration.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to combine my 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise and techno-functional background to drive impactful customer experience and e-commerce solutions at FIS Group.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years in SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, plus strong techno-functional experience bridging business and IT, I am very interested in the Product Manager Customer Experience & E-Commerce role at FIS Group. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Manager Customer Experience & E-Commerce (m/w/d) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Product Manager Customer Experience & E-Commerce role at FIS Group. With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a strong mix of technical depth and techno-functional analysis.

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
